question: Will building permit application BP-2214 for 41 Coldbrook Lane be approved -- either by a decision of the Larkspur County Building Department or by operation of the county's deemed-approval rule -- before 5:00 PM on Friday 11 September 2026?
resolution_note: YES only if, before the deadline, the department has either issued a written approval of BP-2214 or the application has become deemed approved under the county's fifteen-business-day rule. A denial, a still-pending application, or a deemed approval that takes effect after the deadline counts as no.
